step1_analysis.description: A clocked dynamic comparator (StrongARM latch) that evaluates the differential input voltage when the clock goes high, and precharges the internal and output nodes to VDD when the clock is low. It is commonly used in ADCs (like the ring-ADC mentioned in the paper) for fast, low-power voltage comparison.

paper_reference.title: A 4-uA Quiescent-Current Dual-Mode Digitally Controlled Buck Converter IC for Cellular Phone Applications

tdelay.description: Clock-to-Q delay (time from CLK rising edge to output resolving)

sky130_expected.calculation: With W/L=10 (5u/0.5u), the tail current is ~2.5mA. Load capacitance is ~50fF. Slew rate = I/C = 50V/ns. Delay is roughly (1.8V / 2) / 50V/ns = 18ps, plus internal node discharge time.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on standard StrongARM latch performance in 130nm with large W/L ratios.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = C_total * VDD^2 * f_clk. Assuming C_total ~ 100fF, VDD = 1.8V, f_clk = 100MHz (from testbench). P = 100fF * 3.24 * 1e8 = 32.4uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dynamic power dominates in this clocked circuit. Static power is negligible due to the tail switch.

sky130_expected.calculation: Precharged to VDD and held by cross-coupled PMOS.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Full rail-to-rail swing is expected in a StrongARM latch.

sky130_expected.calculation: Pulled to GND by cross-coupled NMOS and tail NMOS.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Full rail-to-rail swing is expected in a StrongARM latch.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure clock-to-Q delay, output voltage levels, and average power consumption for two different input states (INP > INN and INP < INN).
step3_testbench.spice:
* StrongARM Latch Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VCLK CLK 0 PULSE(0 1.8 2n 50p 50p 4n 10n)

* Connect all clock labels to the main CLK source
V0 LABEL_NET_0 CLK 0
V3 LABEL_NET_3 CLK 0
V4 LABEL_NET_4 CLK 0
V5 LABEL_NET_5 CLK 0
V6 LABEL_NET_6 CLK 0

* Differential inputs flipping at 9ns
VINP LABEL_NET_1 0 PWL(0 0.95 9n 0.95 9.1n 0.85 30n 0.85)
VINN LABEL_NET_2 0 PWL(0 0.85 9n 0.85 9.1n 0.95 30n 0.95)

XM1 N2 N0 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N4 LABEL_NET_0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 N2 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N4 LABEL_NET_1 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N1 LABEL_NET_2 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N1 LABEL_NET_3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N3 LABEL_NET_4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N0 LABEL_NET_5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N2 LABEL_NET_6 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N2 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N0 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}

.control
tran 10p 30n

* Cycle 1: INP > INN -> N2 falls, N0 stays high
meas tran tdelay_clk_to_n2_fall trig v(CLK) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(n2) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran n0_high_1 max v(n0) from=3n to=5n
meas tran n2_low_1 min v(n2) from=3n to=5n

* Cycle 2: INP < INN -> N0 falls, N2 stays high
meas tran tdelay_clk_to_n0_fall trig v(CLK) val=0.9 rise=2 targ v(n0) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran n0_low_2 min v(n0) from=13n to=15n
meas tran n2_high_2 max v(n2) from=13n to=15n

* Average Power Calculation
meas tran avg_current avg i(VVDD) from=0 to=30n
let avg_power = -avg_current * 1.8
print avg_power

quit
.endc
